ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth local assistant designed to parse packet captures, extract hidden metadata for steganography, and suggest reverse engineering heuristics without leaking flags.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a real-world bottleneck in cryptography and forensics challenges by turning repetitive math into instant UI widgets, matching the hard engineering focus of top hackathon winners.
